title: Trailforge Studios - Resource Blocks
description: A Vanilla+ resource pack that refreshes Minecraft’s resource blocks while staying true to the original style.
body:
# Trailforge Studios – Resource Blocks

Give Minecraft’s resource blocks a fresh new look while keeping the style you already know.

**Trailforge Studios – Resource Blocks** is a Vanilla+ resource pack that redesigns Minecraft’s resource and storage blocks with cleaner details and a more consistent appearance. The textures stay close to the original game, making them feel like a natural part of Minecraft rather than a completely different art style.

Whether you use them for storage, decoration, or showing off your hard-earned resources, these blocks will fit smoothly into survival worlds and builds.

### Features
- Redesigned resource and storage blocks
- Vanilla+ style
- Clean and consistent textures
- Fits naturally into builds and survival worlds
- Works well alongside other Trailforge Studios packs

A simple visual refresh for some of Minecraft’s most valuable blocks.
